claim_text: Flood waters peaked in the White River at Indianapolis, and rains were expected to ease in the state capital region and other parts of Indiana on Sunday.
quote: Days of storms and flooding in Indiana left at least six people dead as flood waters peaked in Indianapolis’s White River – and rains were expected to ease in the state capital region and other parts of the state on Sunday.
confidence_justification: News ceiling; the peak is a gauge observation but the easing is a forecast expectation reported without attribution.
